map.检测（年检/维修/充装）服务 使用指南: Inspection (Annual Check / Repair / Refill) Service User Guide
map.灭火器年检充装评估工具。按状态检测要点评估灭火器年检、维修与充装服务质量，识别不: Fire extinguisher annual inspection, repair and refill assessment tool. Assesss annual inspection, maintenance and refill service quality against status-check criteria, flags non-conforming items and gives handling advice, for periodic extinguisher management.
map.灭火器月度/年度巡检中，按类型（CO₂/干粉/泡沫/水基）核对年检期限与筒体状况: In monthly and annual extinguisher inspections, check the inspection due date and cylinder condition by type (CO₂ / dry powder / foam / water-based).
map.到期、锈蚀、喷管破损、铅封缺失、标识不清等逐项加扣，量化合格/需维护/需充装更换: Expiry, corrosion, nozzle damage, missing tamper seal, unclear labelling and so on are scored item by item to quantify pass / needs maintenance / needs refill or replacement.
map.压力不足是关键红线，必须送检充装。: Insufficient pressure is the key red line — the unit must be sent for inspection and refilling.
map.算例：水基灭火器、距年检 6 个月、压力正常、无外观问题: Worked example: water-based extinguisher, 6 months until inspection, pressure normal, no external damage
map.：水基最大年检周期 12 个月，6 个月未超期也不临近（>10 个月才提示临近）: : the maximum annual inspection interval for water-based units is 12 months; at 6 months it is neither overdue nor near due (the near-due warning appears only beyond 10 months), pressure scores 0 and nothing is ticked → score = 0 → "conforming", usable within the valid period.
map.：超期（按类型 12/12/24/12 月）加 3 分并提示超期月数；临近到期加: : overdue (12/12/24/12 months by type) adds 3 points and reports the overdue months; near due adds 1 point; corrosion/damage each add +2; missing seal / unclear labelling each add +1; the pressure value counts directly. 0 points = conforming, ≤3 = needs maintenance, >3 = needs refilling or replacement.
map.人员安全疏散时间估算（流量法）: Personnel safe evacuation time estimation (flow rate method)
map.最不利点消火栓水压计算: Pressure at the most unfavourable hydrant point
map.不同类型灭火器的年检周期一样吗？: Is the annual inspection interval the same for all extinguisher types?
map.不一样。本工具取 CO₂/干粉 12 个月、泡沫 24 个月、水基 12 个月（: They differ. This tool uses CO₂/dry powder 12 months, foam 24 months, water-based 12 months (common convention; defer to the latest standard). Overdue items lose points and the overdue months are reported.
map.压力不足为什么必须充装？: Why must insufficient pressure lead to refilling?
map.压力不足意味着内压低于工作范围，喷射距离与灭火能力不达标，存在关键时刻失效风险，: Insufficient pressure means the internal pressure is below the working range, so spray distance and extinguishing capacity fall short and the unit risks failing at the critical moment. This is a hard red line — it must be sent for inspection, refilled or replaced, never used in a defective state.
